     WILLIAMSON COUNTIES



                                         DAN KACIR’S FINAL BRIEF

    TO THE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
    Comes now Dan Kacir, Intervener, and timely files this his final brief regarding the above referenced
    cause number.


                                           STATEMENTS OF FACT
    Dan Kacir incorporates all of ahis previous testimony, exhibits and briefs for all purposes.
    Dan Kacir was not given notice of the movant’s proposed power line through tracts 57747 and 57748
    despite his deeds being filed Since 2012 in the Bell County Clerk’s office which is the official deed
    records. Also Charles Kacir and Samantha Kacir were not given notice despite their deeds for this
    property being properly filed in the official deed records of Bell County, Texas.
    As previously stated this land has been in the family for almost 100 years with multi generations working
    to be good stewards of the land. The proposed link C-2 would bisect our contiguous farm in two pieces
    and would cause great hardships with our operations, purpose and enjoyment of our land. Part of our
    programs have been to preserve wildlife, including but not limited to, protecting and the habitat of the
    tTexas Horned Lizard which is an endangered species and the Texas red harvester ant which makes up
    more than 85 percent of the Texas horned lizards diet and is recognized as a keystone species in the
    Texas eco system. I have not found where movant’s have done any environmental impact study on the
    effects of crossing through these environmentally sensitive areas nor the damages to the artifacts of the
    native Americans who inhabited our land before us.

1
     The proposed route will have to cross through over a mile of the FEMA regulatory flood flow zone which
    is regulated by Federal Law yet I have found no evidence that the movant’s conducted hydrology studies
    as required by law. Putting the proposed structures will likely alter the flow which will result in damages
    to our remaining property.


                                                   ARGUMENT
    My property will suffer irreparable damage and harm for something that myself nor my community will
    receive no benefit. Therefore proposed Link C-2 should be refused in its entirety.
    Movant’s have not shown that there are not more practical alternative to this high volage line that would
    destroy so many people’s work, dreams and heritages.
    Movant’s have not demonstrated a current need or why point of use generation would not be a more
    practical, secure and safe solution.
    Intervener, Dan Kacir reserves the right to use any of his prior testimony, exhibits or briefs for and future
    purpose.


                                                     PRAYER


    Intervener, Dan Kacir, request that the SOAH hearing officers refuse Link C-2 in its entirety and any
    other relief allowed by law.




                                                                           Respectfully submitted,



                                                                                    /s/ Dan Kacir
